scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development STAGE_ENV=local AWS_PROFILE=paprcraft-dev-loy NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1 NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 nodemon --ignore 'src/scripts/*.js' src/app-local.js
scripts.prepare-lambda-layer: rm -rf ../_layer && mkdir ../_layer && mkdir ../_layer/nodejs && cp package.json ../_layer/nodejs/package.json && cd ../_layer/nodejs && npm install --omit=dev
scripts.version-patch: npm version patch && cd src && npm version patch && cd ../
scripts.version-minor: npm version minor && cd src && npm version minor && cd ../
scripts.version-major: npm version major && cd src && npm version major && cd ../
scripts.deploy: yarn version-patch && yarn compile-lambda && yarn update-lambda-stg
scripts.update-lambda-stg: aws lambda update-function-code --profile paprcraft-dev-loy --region ap-southeast-1 --function-name paprcraft-stg-api --zip-file fileb://function.zip
scripts.update-lambda-prod: aws lambda update-function-code --profile paprcraft-dev-loy --region ap-southeast-1 --function-name paprcraft-prod-api --zip-file fileb://function.zip
